title: The Discovered Attack
concept: A discovered attack happens when you move one piece and the piece behind it suddenly attacks something. The moving piece can make its own threat too.
tip: Look for one of your pieces standing in front of a rook, bishop or queen. Move it — and see what the piece behind it now attacks.

feedback.correct: Excellent! Moving that piece revealed a hidden attack — a discovered attack!
feedback.hint: Move a piece out of the way to uncover a powerful attack by the piece behind it.
feedback.reveal: Move one piece to unleash the attack of another piece that was standing behind it.
